title: Phobias and what they are the fear of

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

fear_of.pick: What is someone afraid of if they have {label}?
fear_of.match: Match each phobia to the thing it is a fear of.
fear_of.reverse: Which phobia is the fear of {value}?

rows.label: Claustrophobia
rows.hook: shows up as dread in MRI tubes, stuck elevators and small closets

rows.label: Triskaidekaphobia
rows.hook: leads many buildings to skip a floor and makes an unlucky Friday feel doomed

rows.label: Acrophobia
rows.hook: turns a glass-floored skywalk or a tall balcony into a nightmare

rows.label: Arachnophobia
rows.description: fear of spiders and other arachnids
rows.hook: is the title of a comedy-horror film where deadly eight-legged creatures invade a small town

rows.label: Trypophobia
rows.hook: is an unofficial dread that spread online over lotus seed pods and honeycomb photos

rows.label: Astraphobia
rows.description: abnormal fear of thunder and lightning
rows.hook: is a storm-time dread that sends many pets and people hiding under beds

rows.label: Hemophobia
rows.hook: can make people queasy or faint at a donation drive or lab test

rows.label: Mysophobia
rows.description: pathological fear of contamination and germs
rows.hook: is the dread behind compulsive hand-washing and sanitizer obsession

rows.label: Aquaphobia
rows.description: persistent and abnormal fear of water
rows.hook: keeps people out of swimming pools and off boats

rows.label: Nomophobia
rows.description: fear of being out of cellular phone contact
rows.hook: is a modern anxiety about a dead battery or no signal

rows.label: Algophobia
rows.hook: is dread of hurt itself, from stubbed toes to surgery

rows.label: Cynophobia
rows.hook: makes a walk past a barking yard frightening, and its name comes from the Greek for canine

rows.label: Ailurophobia
rows.hook: is the dread some people feel around purring pets that curl up on laps

rows.label: Ophidiophobia
rows.hook: is the dread Indiana Jones famously admits to when he tumbles into a pit

rows.label: Thalassophobia
rows.description: fear of the sea or of sea travel
rows.hook: makes some people uneasy about murky ocean trenches and what lurks below

rows.label: Hexakosioihexekontahexaphobia
rows.description: aversion to the number 666 or "number of the beast"
rows.hook: is a famously huge word tied to the ominous mark in the Book of Revelation

rows.label: Glossophobia
rows.description: fear of public speaking or of speaking in general
rows.hook: is stage fright at a podium, said to rank among the most common fears

rows.label: Autophobia
rows.hook: is dread of solitude, named from the Greek word for self

rows.label: Trypanophobia
rows.description: phobia of medical procedures involving injections or needles
rows.hook: makes vaccinations and blood draws a source of dread

rows.label: Emetophobia
rows.hook: is dread of stomach bugs and seasick queasiness

rows.label: Entomophobia
rows.hook: is a dread of creepy-crawlies such as ants, flies and cockroaches

rows.label: Phonophobia
rows.description: fear of or aversion to loud sounds
rows.hook: makes fireworks, sirens and thunderclaps unbearable

rows.label: Necrophobia
rows.description: irrational fear of dead things as well as things associated with death
rows.hook: is dread triggered by graveyards, funerals and corpses

rows.label: Coulrophobia
rows.hook: is tied to scary circus performers with red noses, such as Stephen King's Pennywise

rows.label: Haphephobia
rows.description: rare specific phobia that involves the fear of touching or of being touched
rows.hook: makes handshakes and hugs a source of dread

rows.label: Aichmophobia
rows.hook: makes knives, scissors and pins feel threatening

rows.label: Tokophobia
rows.hook: is dread of labor and delivery in the maternity ward

rows.label: Ablutophobia
rows.description: pathological fear of bathing, cleaning, or washing with water
rows.hook: makes bath time or a shower something a child may dread

rows.label: Philophobia
rows.description: fear of being in love and falling in love
rows.hook: is dread of romance and commitment, named from a Greek word for affection

rows.label: Neophobia
rows.description: fear or dislike of new things
rows.hook: shows up in picky toddlers refusing unfamiliar foods and in people resisting change

rows.label: Taphophobia
rows.hook: fed a Victorian-era worry that led to coffins fitted with bells and escape devices

rows.label: Odontophobia
rows.description: abnormal fear or dread of visiting the dentist
rows.hook: is dread of drills and checkups in a chair under a bright light

rows.label: Herpetophobia
rows.hook: covers scaly crawlers like lizards, turtles and crocodiles

rows.label: Ornithophobia
rows.hook: is the dread played on by a Hitchcock thriller where flocks attack a seaside town

rows.label: Osmophobia
rows.hook: is dread of strong stenches and heavy perfumes

rows.label: Bibliophobia
rows.hook: makes a library visit or a pile of paperbacks unnerving

rows.label: Hypnophobia
rows.hook: makes bedtime a source of anxiety, and is named for the Greek god of slumber

rows.label: Pyrophobia
rows.hook: makes campfires, matches and candles unnerving

rows.label: Apiphobia
rows.hook: is dread of buzzing hive-dwellers that make honey

rows.label: Scopophobia
rows.description: fear of being seen or stared at by others
rows.hook: makes eye contact and standing in the spotlight uncomfortable

rows.label: Ichthyophobia
rows.description: fear of traditional and non traditional fishes
rows.hook: is dread of swimming scaly creatures in aquariums and lakes

rows.label: Nyctophobia
rows.hook: is why many kids need a night-light

rows.label: Amaxophobia
rows.hook: makes getting behind the wheel, or even riding along, scary

rows.label: Gelotophobia
rows.description: type of social phobia consisting in the fear of being laughed at
rows.hook: is dread of mockery and ridicule

rows.label: Musophobia
rows.hook: is the dread behind the cartoon stereotype of a person on a chair shrieking at a tiny rodent

rows.label: Gephyrophobia
rows.description: specific phobia characterized by the fear of bridges
rows.hook: makes crossing a span over a river or gorge terrifying

rows.label: Heliophobia
rows.hook: is an aversion to daytime glare and beach days

rows.label: Ranidaphobia
rows.description: phobia known as frog phobia or ranidaphobia
rows.hook: is dread of slimy green hoppers, the pond kind that become princes in fairy tales

rows.label: Apeirophobia
rows.hook: is dread of endlessness, such as never-ending space or time

rows.label: Anthophobia
rows.hook: is dread of roses, tulips and bouquets

rows.label: Hippopotomonstrosesquipedaliophobia
rows.hook: is a cruel joke of a name, itself a tongue-twisting mouthful of Latin and Greek roots

rows.label: Demophobia
rows.description: morbid fear of crowds or overcrowding
rows.hook: makes stadiums, festivals and packed subways feel suffocating

rows.label: Equinophobia
rows.hook: is dread of stallions, mares and ponies
